messages:
sanjay: heads-up from the postmortem - repeating incident pattern: unscoped flag + config drift during rollout. we need short, actionable followups.
tara: agree. propose three focused changes: 1) short auto-mitigation flow (soft-shrink -> flag-kill), 2) default flag scope caps, 3) postmortem tracker fields for guardrail presence.
sanjay: owners and deadlines: TARA -> scope caps doc + PR (Wed EOD); LEO -> auto-mitigation infra spec + pseudocode (Mon noon); SRE (ops-bot) -> canary error-heatmap tile + alert (Thu).
leo: pseudo: `if errors(2m)>0.03 or p99>baseline+150ms -> reduce_sample(50%); wait 3m -> if not recovered -> trigger_flag_kill()`
tara: default caps suggestion: 1% global, 5% region. require justification and approver for >5%.
ops-bot: created TICK-4222 for infra + TICK-4223 for observability. use `/claim` to assign.
sanjay: add tracker column `guardrail_active` and taxonomy: config-drift / scope-leak / infra-threshold / model-regression. assigning myself to backfill last 12 incidents (due Fri).
leo: adding test plan to infra PR to validate flag-kill latency <200ms.
tara: also adding PR template checkbox for pre-rollout smoke and scope rationale.
sanjay: decisions noted. 15m async check-in next Wed to confirm progress. ping 10m before. :thumbsup:
